entries.zh: 痣；皮肤上的黑痣〔西语词头 Fondo/suelo（底、地）与汉字栏不合，释义存疑〕
entries.en: bottom, ground (fondo, suelo); but the Chinese gloss reads 痣 'mole' — entry internally inconsistent
entries.notes: 西语词头 Fondo/suelo（底、地）与汉字'痣'、音写 Fey 不相合，词头或汉字栏必有一误；官话栏空缺。

entries.zh: 野汉（粗野亡命之人）；亡命徒、流窜歹徒
entries.notes: 汉字栏作'野候[疑:候/侯]'，依音写 yà hân 当为'野汉'，字面存疑。

entries.en: to force through, to push past
entries.notes: 音写 âr 与汉字'過'不对应，义项依西语 forzar 与'過'推断。

entries.en: to jam, to force in; to obstruct
entries.notes: 音写为多音节短语（N.n nge dunger hinaż）无法切分，'梗'与 forzar 的语义衔接存疑。

entries.en: to force out, to expel; to drive back
entries.notes: 汉字'返'（回返）与西语 echándolo fuera（扔出去）方向相左，音写 Siǒg 疑为'逐'，义项存疑。

entries.en: to carry off by force, to take away by force
to force (someone) to go away; to oust, expel
entries.notes: 音写 guè 与汉字'革'（kek/gik）不对应，'革＝强令逐离'系推断。

entries.en: to seize and carry off captive, to abduct by force
entries.notes: 音写中段 T99 污损难辨；汉字'拏/挐'存疑，义项依西语 cautivo 与'拏'推断。

entries.en: to press down, to hold down; to suppress
entries.notes: 西语补语 'in le alamand' 无法解读，义项依汉字'抑'与音写 è。

entries.en: to force, to coerce (to use force upon)
to bend or break by force, to wrest against resistance
to press hard, to hound and coerce
entries.notes: 音写含 T99 污损；西语 'que yennis' 无法解读，义项依汉字'追迫'。

entries.zh: 拂意；强逆其意、强人所难
entries.en: to force someone's will, to go against the will
to rape, to violate a woman

entries.zh: 灌水；强行灌水入口（逼饮）
entries.en: to force water down (someone's throat), to pour water into
to wrench, to twist by force; to seize and drag away

entries.zh: 作威福；倚势强令、作威作福
entries.en: to lord it over, to abuse authority to compel others
entries.notes: 音写含 T99 污损；西语 'anona Cān?' 无法解读，义项依汉字'作威福'（作威作福）。
